idea-plugin.name: InputBridge
idea-plugin.description:
Type on an ADB-connected Android device from Android Studio, and bring its clipboard back.

  • Unicode input: send any text, including CJK characters and emoji, to the focused control on the device, optionally replacing the text it already holds.
  • Device clipboard: fetch the device clipboard on demand or follow its changes live, with bold, italic, colors, links, and other formatting shown in the editor.
  • Multiple devices: the device list follows USB attach, detach, and authorization changes, devices can be switched from the dialog, and dropped connections recover automatically.
  • Favorites and history: save titled snippets that can be searched, reordered, imported, and exported, and restore recently delivered input.

How it works. InputBridge pushes a small helper JAR to /data/local/tmp and runs it with app_process over ADB. No APK is installed and the input method is not changed. The helper is removed when you disconnect, switch devices, or close the project.

Privacy. Text, clipboard content, favorites, and history stay on your computer and device. InputBridge collects no telemetry and sends nothing over the network.

Open it from Tools | InputBridge or the main toolbar. Requires Android 8.0 or newer with USB debugging enabled.
